title: Neon Neural Eye
description: A surreal portrait of a woman's face enclosed within a transparent spherical bubble against a black background. Her right eye is strikingly bright blue while the center of the sphere contains a glowing pink orb emitting numerous neon pink, purple and blue neural tendrils that connect to the inner surface of the bubble.
